description.value: Gehringer Brothers Estate Winery is a family-owned estate winery established in 1985 on the Golden Mile Bench near Oliver in the South Okanagan, where Walter and Gordon Gehringer — BC-born winemakers trained in Europe — produce an extensive range from sparkling and whites to icewines. Their Minus 9 Icewine has earned Double Platinum 'Best of the Best' recognition from Wine Press Northwest, and the winery has been described as 'one of the finest wine producers anywhere on the west coast.' Wine can be purchased at the on-site wine shop or ordered online for Canadian delivery.
